name: finmate
description: FinMate - Cố vấn tài chính cá nhân all-in-one (tự động hoá thu chi, phân bổ quỹ, mục tiêu, FIRE)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.start:lan: npm run build -w web && npm run start:lan -w server
scripts.test:all: npm test -w server && npm run test:smoke -w server && npm run test:sim -w server && npm run test:app -w web && npm run test:e2e -w web
